IsolateCentral.definition: Processing time for isolating at the central system for each intervention

ScanCentral.definition: Processing time for scanning at the central system for each intervention

IsolateDistributed.definition: Processing time for isolating at the distributed system for each intervention

ScanDistributed.definition: Processing time for scanning at the distributed system for each intervention

CentralMaxHours.definition: Maximum hours of operation for the central system

DistributedMaxHours.definition: Maximum hours of operation for the distributed system

objective.description: Minimize the total cost of interventions (central and distributed processing) required to halt the intruder’s progress, subject to processing time and maximum hour constraints.
